responsibility: Implements JSON I/O for target specifications by parsing custom target JSON objects into `Target`/`TargetOptions` plus warnings, validating and translating the external field schema into internal enums and settings, and serializing targets back to the canonical compatibility-preserving JSON form.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the top-level `json.rs`, this file is specific to target specification JSON: it maps the external target-spec schema to and from `Target`/`TargetOptions`, including field-name compatibility, parsing of many target-option enums/settings, validation, and warning collection. It uses the generic `ToJson` support from `crate::json` rather than defining that shared conversion layer itself.
